consumers.active_contract: HostResourceFacade public methods and reservation/owner DTOs
consumers.target: DeviceSchedulerProjectControlAdapter injected with the public async SDK; allocation, renewal, release, inventory and owner queries use Device Scheduler MCP operations
consumers.migration_rule: Unsupported legacy semantics fail closed. Managed model lifecycle callers migrate to backend/handoff semantics instead of emulating these calls as raw leases.

consumers.active_contract: Supervisor reserves GPU bundles through HostResourceFacade, adjusts priority, polls preemption, tracks residency-process identity, renews owner heartbeats, and releases only after verified model-process and GPU-memory quiescence. LocalWorkerRuntime constructs the facade with HostCoordinator by default. Model inference and Project Control agent/task coordination remain Project Control responsibilities.
consumers.target: Inject the Device Scheduler SDK and backend client at the LocalWorkerRuntime composition seam. Device Scheduler registers, starts, inspects, and owns the managed model process/backend and its residency allocation; Project Control retains inference RPC against the ready backend endpoint. Use handoffs.submit/control only with an explicit eviction grant and a verified consumer-drain contract. Consumers without that integration are registered as non-evictable and handoff is refused. Ordinary lease API is only for independently scoped reservations.
preserve: model-service API and Project Control ownership

consumers.active_contract: Read physical resource owner records and reject writes while conflicting owners remain
consumers.target: leases.list/get and backends.list/get through the injected Device Scheduler client; expose ledger state separately from verified process/backend observations

consumers.active_contract: Fence AS1 writes using live owner and active reservation counts from the PC-owned SQLite database
consumers.target: Replace direct SQLite ownership read with authenticated leases/backend queries and fail closed on unavailable or unknown scheduler state

consumers.active_contract: Require zero active owners, allocations, and foreground intents before accepting physical-release observations; verify exact owner IDs have no remaining active reservations.
consumers.target: Query Device Scheduler leases and backend observations through the injected authenticated SDK. Count unresolved, release-requested, reclaiming, unknown, or expired claims as still held; fail closed when the authority is unavailable.

consumers.active_contract: Execute registered GPU campaign through the legacy controller and retain campaign result/evidence
consumers.target: Submit a bounded job using an operator-registered profile; keep Project Control campaign validation and evidence presentation
